Tiszavid Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Petőfi Sándor utca 13, Hungary

Demolished. Tiszavid's Jewish community is first documented in 1840, with 10 residents; the population peaked at 60 in 1880 before declining to just 6 by 1941. The community was likely too small to support its own institutions, probably belonging instead to the larger Jewish community of Vásárosnamény, from where its members were likely gathered into the ghetto in May 1944 before deportation to Auschwitz. This cemetery was demolished and built over at an unknown time; according to izraelitatemetok.hu, its tombstones were allegedly transferred to Beregdaróc, documented elsewhere in this collection, and a general store was built on the site.
